task.description:
git checkout feature/WF03-ISS0720-20260919 (already pushed by Step 00) before doing anything. Step 0.5 + Step 1 of WF-03: diagnose the bug ai-dala-infra's T-0138 (artifacts_in) reports, root-caused and corroborated independently by ISS-0719 (artifacts_in, a live QA BLOCKER this same bug caused). Reproduce/confirm from source directly, not from the two reports' prose alone: lib/letflow/routers/tenant_config.ex's private oidc_issuer_base/0 reads Application.get_env(:letflow, :oidc, [])[:issuer], but REQ-370's config/runtime.exs (and config/dev.exs, config/test.exs) all renamed/moved that key to :keycloak_base_url and never set :issuer anywhere -- confirm this yourself via a targeted grep across config/, quoting what you find. Effect: oidc_issuer_base/0 always returns nil in every environment, so idp_base_url/0 falls through past it straight to System.get_env("BPM_IDP_BASE_URL")/System.get_env("KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL") or, if neither env var is set, the compiled @default_idp_base_url = "http://localhost:8082" (a local-dev value) -- exactly what happened on live QA before an env-var mitigation (T-0137, external, already applied) papered over it operationally without touching this code defect.

As part of Step 0.5, check docs/issues/ for a prior resolved entry with matching symptoms (none is expected -- ISS-0719 is open, not resolved, and describes the QA-visible symptom rather than this stale-call-site root cause -- but verify rather than assume).

As part of Step 1, FILE a new issue record at docs/issues/ISS-0720.yaml (next sequential number, confirmed via `ls docs/issues/` before you pick it) describing this root cause precisely (the stale :issuer key, the always-nil oidc_issuer_base/0, the unsafe localhost fallback), with related_requirements: [REQ-370], related: [ISS-0719], severity MAJOR (it is the root cause of ISS-0719's BLOCKER, but is itself now operationally mitigated by T-0137's env-var override so is not, by itself, currently live-breaking), status: open (ISSUE-FIXER's own diagnosis step files it; Step 5 later in this same run flips it to resolved once the fix lands). Do NOT implement the fix yourself. Your result.summary must state the root cause (not just symptom), the affected file/function, and what a fix needs to change -- including an explicit recommendation on the open design question T-0138 raised and deliberately left unresolved: should @default_idp_base_url ("http://localhost:8082") remain as a last-resort dev-only fallback, or should the code fail loudly instead when no real IDP base URL can be resolved in a real deployment? State your reasoning either way; CODE-DESIGNER will make the final call at Step 2 but your diagnosis should recommend one.
acceptance_criteria: docs/issues/ISS-0720.yaml created, status: open, citing the exact stale-config-key root cause (not the QA symptom alone), related_requirements: [REQ-370], related: [ISS-0719]
result.summary states root cause, affected function (oidc_issuer_base/0, idp_base_url/0), and what CODE-DESIGNER's fix needs to change, with a recommendation on the localhost-default question
Diagnosis is grounded in a direct read/grep of tenant_config.ex and every config/*.exs file with an :oidc key, quoted in the summary -- not restated from T-0138/ISS-0719's prose alone
No fix code is written in this step
